event.description: Use centered affine rank-10 positional SVD factorization
event.proposal: Family: position representation. Current retained frontier is 3,040 parameters at 99.850000%, a +0.850000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 3 prior attempts in this family. There is no accepted in-family result; the most recent failed result is attempt-0024, a valid rank-10 uncentered SVD candidate that scored 25.18% official accuracy at 3,002 parameters. Hypothesis: the uncentered factor spent rank on the table mean; preserving that mean exactly as a 16D projection bias and applying rank-10 SVD to centered residuals raises retained residual energy to 99.7506% while still yielding 3,018 parameters. This is a changed affine factorization, not a retry of the failed approximation. It is more informative than the nearest untested centered rank 9 because rank 10 is the least-lossy centered factor that remains strictly smaller than the incumbent.
